failed_checks: Paraphrase says ISO 26262/21448 functional safety 'is to be ensured' and ISO 35402 framework 'is to be applied'. Source (p.8, 5(2)) says functional safety is ensured as a premise ('行った上で') and that applying an ISO 35402 based framework to evaluate safety 'is conceivable' (考えられる); other methods are not precluded. Wording is permissive, not directive. Document does not state its binding effect. Actor: manufacturer (製造事業者) mentioned in the same paragraph.
what_source_says: Section 5(2), p.8: after ensuring functional safety based on ISO 26262, ISO 21448 (SOTIF) etc., safety may be evaluated by applying a safety evaluation framework based on ISO 35402 etc.; other methods not excluded. 2nd edition revised 30 Sep 2025, first issued 7 Jun 2024.
suggested_fix: Reword to: 'After functional safety is ensured on the basis of ISO 26262 and ISO 21448 (SOTIF), safety can be evaluated by applying a framework based on ISO 35402; the text presents this as one conceivable approach and does not exclude others.' Keep guidance. Who_tests: vehicle manufacturer (製造事業者) as named in the section, not otherwise confirmed.
